subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a separate New messages indicator mode, and should it live as browser-local Control UI state rather than a gateway WebChat config key?
rationale: The code path is narrow, but the requested behavior changes a catch-up affordance and the proposed config shape conflicts with the documented retired WebChat config surface.

options.title: Browser-local indicator mode
options.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while retaining an accessible jump-to-latest action.

options.title: Keep current catch-up affordance
options.body: Treat the existing auto-scroll modes as sufficient and keep New messages as the mandatory manual catch-up control.

options.title: Reopen gateway config
options.body: Add a documented gateway WebChat config key only if maintainers want operator-level policy with schema and doctor implications.

recommendation.title: Browser-local indicator mode
recommendation.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while retaining an accessible jump-to-latest action.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev authored the adjacent auto-scroll selector and already separated this issue from that merged work in live discussion.
